newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka troops kill 19 rebels, smash camp in east.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka troops kill 19 rebels, smash camp in east.

text.p: Sri Lankan forces smashed a Tamil rebel base and killed at least 19 separatist guerrillas on Wednesday, a day after launching an offensive to clear rebel bases in the eastern province, military officials said.

Forces, backed by aircraft and artillery, overran a camp of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) at Rukam, a remote village southwest of Batticaloa town, 240 km (150 miles) east of Colombo, military officials in the area told Reuters.

At least 14 rebels who were at the camp were killed in the afternoon attack by the military, who launched "Operation Rivijaya" in the early hours of Tuesday to clear parts of the east from rebel domination, the military officials said.
Earlier in the day, troops confronted and killed another five rebels a few miles (km) south of Rukam, they added.
Rukam is along the Maha Oya-Chenkaladi highway, a supply route for the military, which connects the coastal town of Batticaloa to the island's interior.

The LTTE, fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in this Indian Ocean island's north and east, was not immediately available for comment. The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the toll is much higher.
